title: Invert the execution-gate guard — evidence required to reach a Stage-2 roster
note: THE LOAD-BEARING CHANGE. Today check_dry_run_in_diff.py blocks turning a leg OFF and nothing blocks turning one ON; across 78 guards there is no counterpart. Demotion becomes free; promotion to a real-money roster requires a fresh evidence record clearing its declared bar. Tier-2 (CI + order-path policy) and needs the operator on the bar definition. [!] REFINED 2026-09-21 BY RUNNING THE GUARD, not by reading it: check_dry_run_in_diff.py matches ADDED `mode: dry_run` / `execution: shadow` LINES, so there are TWO spellings of 'off' and it sees only one. Removing a leg from an account's strategies: roster is NOT guarded -- verified against the A6 diff, which removes two legs from alpaca_live and reports `clean`. SO B1 MUST KEY ON ROSTER MEMBERSHIP, not on the mode/execution fields: a guard watching only the fields can be walked around by editing the list, in either direction. This also matters for the mandates -- MD-PROMOTE-S1-S2 adds a leg to a roster, which is exactly the edit the current guard cannot see. [!] OPERATOR DECIDED THE BAR 2026-09-21: THE FOUR CLAUSES AS WRITTEN — named harness · stated n · net of the FULL cost stack · clearing a rule registered BEFORE the run. They were offered a fifth clause (an explicit minimum n, prompted by tlt_pullback_1d having reached a real-money roster on n=8) and declined it. RECORD THAT THEY WERE ASKED: the absence of a sample-size floor is now a decision, not an oversight, and a successor proposing one is re-opening a settled question rather than spotting a gap. [!] UNBLOCKED FOR DISPATCH — this row's content question is answered, so the lane builds rather than asks. [!] DISPATCHED 2026-09-21 on OPUS, not sonnet, and the reason is the task table's own rule rather than a preference: this guard decides what may reach a REAL-MONEY ROSTER. It writes no order, but it is the thing standing between a passing number and live capital once B5 removes the human, and 'anything on a real-money order path' is read here as including the gate on that path. [!] LANE FENCED HARD out of changing any roster, mode or execution VALUE — it builds the guard only. If the guard fails current main, that is a FINDING TO REPORT, not a licence to edit config. [!] TOLD the minimum-n clause was OFFERED AND DECLINED, so it does not re-add one and does not read its absence as a gap. [!] LANE RESULT 2026-09-21 -- PR #12688 (draft, landing=hold; the manager merges). scripts/ci/check_roster_promotion_evidence.py keys on ROSTER MEMBERSHIP (parsed roster at the fork point vs HEAD), registered in run_guards.py, 16 real-config tests, COVERAGE_FLOOR ratcheted 43->44. ASYMMETRY MEASURED rather than inherited: the full 73-guard fleet run against a COMMITTED real promotion (tlt_pullback_1d -> alpaca_live) fails exactly ONE guard, this one; the only other red, pr-landing-guard, is orthogonal -- filling its landing declaration with the plant still present turns it green. POPULATION: 12 roster slots across 4 risk-bearing accounts, 0 clear the four-clause bar. 11 fail C3 (fee-only corpus: no slippage or funding in any of the 52 records) and C4 (param_selection_provenance `not_established` on 52 of 52); bybit_2/fvg_range_15m fails all four (coverage_state no_harness). The guard is DIFF-SCOPED so those 12 are grandfathered -- carried as PI-20260921-0011, blocked on D1 and B5. CI green on 0d09f6070 (guards, pytest-run, pytest-collect, repo-inventory) after one real failure of mine: a --base guard must call the shared _dirty_tree.warn(); fixed and the full suite re-run (17974 passed). [!] OPEN QUESTION FOR THE OPERATOR, the one thing this lane could not settle: C3/C4 check for blocks no producer writes yet, so the guard currently blocks ALL real-money promotion rather than discriminating. That matches the standing note that the promote mandate does not arm until D1 -- but whether that interim behaviour is intended is a decision, not a build. [!] MERGED 2026-09-21 as c08c60b. THE FINDING IS THE NUMBER, not the guard: 12 legs on a risk-bearing roster, 0 clearing the four-clause bar; 11 of 12 fail exactly C3 and C4; `param_selection_provenance` reads `not_established` on 52 of 52 committed records. Since 'if the evidence supports it' is the entire safety property once nobody is in the path, that is the state of that property today. [!] AND THE ASYMMETRY IS NOW MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSERTED: of 73 registered guards, exactly one fails on a real-money roster promotion, and before this PR that number was zero. Verified with a matched-pair negative control -- the identical edit is silent on bybit_1 (paper) and fires on bybit_2 (real money) -- so the silence is a measurement. [!] ⚠️ $270.39 AGAINST A $35 CEILING. The most expensive lane of the day, and the one with the best evidence discipline. Both facts are on the row.
